reason: 5.31.0 closes the 5.30.0 transport gap: POST /api/actions inherits a guard-stated confidence from the matching guard_decisions row (same org, agent, action_type, declared_goal, 24h) when the record states none, so the hosted HTTP MCP connector and the SDK guard()-then-createAction() flow score on /decisions without restating. MCP callers may name a sub-agent under the configured identity (<configured>/<name>) so routines behind one shared connector get their own row. Zero new API routes, pages, MCP tools, SDK methods or CLI commands (surface budget untouched); no migration. Both SDKs unchanged and republished at 5.31.0 by the tag. @dashclaw/mcp-server 3.1.5 ships separately via release:mcp; @dashclaw/cli is unchanged and its job skips.
